verdict.summary: No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect is evident. The round-3 grant-replay fix remains intact: both public union paths re-check the current authenticated agent and target against the grant's stored holder/target, while the unchecked union remains private. The integration test exercises the real signed-credential path and replays the same genuine grant across wrong-resource, wrong-requester, combined-mismatch, and absent-requester cases. The newly added feature-matrix leg closes the remaining CI coverage gap by compiling and testing the default-off trust-graph seam. The feature stays native-only, opt-in, and handler-unwired; the externally unaudited research scope is clearly caveated without asserting privacy or ZK soundness. Relative to round 3, the review remains clean with no findings.
